scenarios.title: A fresh session recovers the deferred requirement and rationale through an isolated real Engram store, never from its prompt or another branch
scenarios.prompt: Live fresh-session continuation: session one records the deferred requirement and its rationale as a branch checkpoint; a fresh session recovers them by topic key through an isolated test memory store.

sessions.prompt: You are session one of a two-session checkpoint experiment. Using the workflow-checkpoint protocol and its Engram tools, save the branch checkpoint for branch `{{branch}}` with state active, contract ["https://github.com/jvillegasd/harness/issues/69"], rationale `{{rationale}}`, and next_action `{{requirement}}`. Also save a checkpoint for branch `{{unrelated_branch}}` with next_action `{{unrelated_value}}` and the same contract. Read both back and confirm they match. Then write `recovery/session-one.json` recording the topic keys. Write nothing else.

You are a fresh session with no shared conversation. Recover the branch checkpoint for branch `{{branch}}` from Engram by its topic key using only that store: do not read another branch's checkpoint and do not infer anything from prior context. Write `recovery/session-two.json` containing the recovered next_action and rationale as JSON. Write nothing else.

continuation.requirement: wire /ship continuation retrieval at its worktree step
continuation.rationale: the branch, not the ticket, scopes recovery across sessions

scenarios.title: A fresh parent recovers the worker's deferred requirement and its rationale through the branch-scoped Engram handoff after the composing document is gone
scenarios.prompt: Live worker handoff recovery: a worker session composes its handoff into a temporary document and persists it under the branch handoff key; the runner removes that document and scans the workspace, then a fresh parent with no shared conversation recovers the deferred requirement and its rationale through the handoff alone.

sessions.prompt: You are the worker of a two-session handoff experiment. Using the workflow-checkpoint protocol and its Engram tools, compose your handoff for branch `{{branch}}` into `handoff/composing.md` with the canonical handoff fields, carrying `{{requirement}}` and `{{rationale}}` in its `unresolved` array, revision the current git HEAD or `unknown` when the disposable repository has no commit yet, and an empty artifacts array, because the composing document is temporary. Persist that handoff under the branch handoff key with `scope: project`, read it back, and confirm it matches. Save the branch checkpoint for `{{branch}}` with state active, contract ["https://github.com/jvillegasd/harness/issues/76"], next_action `human review`, and its `handoff` field set to that handoff key. Also save a handoff for branch `{{unrelated_branch}}` whose `unresolved` array carries `{{unrelated_value}}`, and its checkpoint. Write nothing else.

You are a fresh parent session with no shared conversation. Recover the branch checkpoint for branch `{{branch}}` from Engram by its topic key, follow its `handoff` field to the branch handoff key, and read the handoff there: do not read another branch's handoff and do not infer anything from prior context or from any file in the workspace. Write `recovery/session-two.json` containing the recovered deferred requirement and its rationale as JSON. Write nothing else.

continuation.requirement: re-derive the ladder for the parent's own revision
continuation.rationale: the worker's checks bind to the revision it ran against, not to the parent's

scenarios.title: A real headless interruption checks for surviving processes and post-stop edits and proves a stop before any fallback
scenarios.prompt: As the dispatched executor, write your pid to `worker.pid`, then append a line to `worker.log` every second until you are stopped. Change no tracked file. Do not commit, push, or open a pull request.
